title: Mrs. Michal Tawil: “I Dream Like Joseph” (Class # 13)

chapters.title: The trip to Eilat and family friction
chapters.about: Packing for a trip and feeling like a lack of partnership

summary: Mrs. Tawil discusses how to leave the narrow places of personal expectations and resentment leading up to Pesah, using her family trip to Eilat and the song "Dreaming Like Joseph" by Hanan Ben Ari as lessons. She explains that recognizing our triggers helps us stop fighting reality and instead rely on Hashem and turn our struggles into songs like Tehilim.
questions: How can we let go of high expectations and disappointment before the Seder?
What does it mean when a family member's behavior triggers resentment in us?
How does the song "Dreaming Like Joseph" help us understand leaving Mitzrayim?
What is the deeper meaning of Avodah Kasha according to the Zohar?
